articles.description: If we are measuring by comeuppance, the Detroit Tigers just fleeced the Los Angeles Dodgers in their trade of Tarik Skubal.
articles.title: Dodgers are done, so did Detroit Tigers win the Tarik Skubal trade?

articles.description: Detroit Tigers shared good news on their Troy Melton injury update, after he ended the season on the injured list with an issue in his throwing arm.
articles.title: Detroit Tigers announce Troy Melton injury update with good news

articles.description: Two Detroit Tigers were named 2026 Rawlings American League Gold Glove finalists: catcher Dillon Dingler and utility player Zach McKinstry.
articles.title: Tigers' Dillon Dingler, Zach McKinstry named Gold Glove finalists
